📺 The Neighborhood (2018–2026)

The Neighborhood follows Dave Johnson, a friendly and optimistic man who moves with his wife Gemma and their young son Grover from Michigan to a predominantly Black neighborhood in Pasadena, California. Excited to make new friends and become part of the community, Dave quickly discovers that winning over his next-door neighbor, Calvin Butler, won’t be as easy as he imagined. Calvin is a proud, outspoken, and traditional family man who isn’t particularly interested in Dave’s overly enthusiastic attempts at friendship. However, as their families spend more time together, they begin developing an unexpected bond filled with hilarious misunderstandings, cultural differences, and heartwarming moments. Alongside Calvin’s loving wife Tina and their sons Malcolm and Marty, the Johnson and Butler families navigate everyday challenges, relationships, parenting, and community life. Starring Cedric the Entertainer, Max Greenfield, Tichina Arnold, and Beth Behrs, the series delivers entertaining comedy, unforgettable characters, and meaningful lessons about friendship, family, acceptance, and bringing people together despite their differences.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Jim Reynolds

📺 Seasons: 8 • Final season airing in 2026

📚 Setting: Pasadena, California

📺 Where to Watch: CBS • Paramount+ (United States)

source_details.synopsis: The Neighborhood is an American television sitcom created by Jim Reynolds that aired on CBS from October 1, 2018 to May 11, 2026. The series follows a white Midwestern family as they adjust to moving into a predominantly black neighborhood in Pasadena, California. It stars Cedric the Entertainer, Max Greenfield, Tichina Arnold, Beth Behrs, Sheaun McKinney, Marcel Spears and Hank Greenspan.
